title: Universal Variety Reduction to Middle Cohomology, Cayley Calibration Orthogonality, and the Quaternary Diamond Projector Split
description: We formalize Step 3 of the Hodge global closure program for arbitrary smooth projective varieties. Using the classical Hard Lefschetz slicing theorem, primitive Hodge classes on any n-dimensional smooth variety reduce inductively to the middle cohomology of complete intersection fourfolds. We prove that the Cayley 4-form calibration eliminates cross-coupling terms, locking the higher-dimensional Schur sine to unity, while the four-Rosetta quaternary diamond projectors form an exact orthogonal idempotent partition of unity. All proofs are certified in Lean 4 with zero sorry and zero custom axioms. In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
